intent.raw: define design and plan the full formalization process for every new UI type, reusing existing types and edges when positive evidence supports coverage or collapse
intent.objective: Execute one governed Form pilot, produce a bounded candidate disposition, and extract a reusable process only after audit.

subagent_strategy.trigger: No planned stage is safely parallel before the Form pilot resolves its prerequisite gates.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use local sequential Task Sessions. Any future evidence fanout requires a fresh domainspec-subagents-strategy proposal and user authorization.

steps.name: Author and validate candidate experiment package
stop_conditions: block missing define/design/plan gates, SWU execution detail, or Distill closure

steps.name: Freeze contract and Form preregistration
stop_conditions: block any disposition ambiguity, authority payload, or post-result preregistration mutation

steps.name: Execute coverage and candidate evidence experiments

inputs.ref: corpus B source/authorship evidence when supplied

outputs.ref: runs/SWU-UCFE-003 through SWU-UCFE-006 receipts or branch skip/block receipts

steps.evidence_artifact: experiments/form coverage and separation run reports
stop_conditions: block pooled alternatives, collapse from missing evidence, synthetic corpus substitution, or preregistration drift

steps.name: Collect review and compose Form disposition

inputs.ref: two reviewer identity and independence attestations when supplied

stop_conditions: block reviewer duplication, threshold tailoring, prohibited disposition, or authority mutation

steps.name: Extract reusable profile and audit pilot
stop_conditions: block Form evidence leakage, automatic rollout, hidden authority claim, or incomplete receipt closeout

gates.condition: Define/design/plan artifacts, full dispatch, Distill result, tasks, waves, and SWUs validate.
Existing coverage uses one complete six-dimension alternative; partial alternatives are never pooled.
Distinct support requires 2 independent corpora, 2 styles, and 2 independent agreeing reviewers.
Candidate dispositions and handoffs cannot mutate definitions, relationships, status, or promotion.
Reusable profile extraction follows an audited pilot and contains no Form evidence or conclusion.

boundaries.contract: Execute exactly one selected SWU with strict context and terminal receipt.
Execute preregistered repeatable experiments and return source-bound receipts.
External source and review evidence requires identity, independence, digest, and provenance attestations.
Disposition is a handle-only review request and grants no canonical mutation or promotion.

boundaries.from_owner: external source and canonical authority namespaces
boundaries.contract: External sources and authority are read-only; run artifacts append only inside the UCFE package.

state_namespaces.write_policy: One selected SWU writes only its declared package paths and run evidence.
Read-only; store handles and attestations in UCFE.

promotion_splits.rule: No experiment disposition changes canonical authority without a separate governance decision.

promotion_guardrails: Missing distinction is not collapse evidence.
Existing coverage requires positive equivalence and no-loss evidence.
Distinct support requires every hard conjunct and fixed 2/2/2.
One candidate's evidence never counts for another candidate.
A Form pilot result cannot become a reusable default conclusion.
Candidate dispositions and owner handoffs are not activation, promotion, or authority mutation.
